interpretations: For each media type ID with matching tracks, calculate its rate as total `Bytes` divided by total `Milliseconds`; count all matching tracks; keep rates above the unweighted average of the media type rates; report the rate minus that average

For each media type ID, calculate its rate as the average of its tracks’ individual `Bytes / Milliseconds` rates; count all matching tracks; keep rates above the unweighted average of the media type rates; report the rate minus that average

For each media type ID, calculate total `Bytes / Milliseconds` using only tracks with non-null `Bytes`; count all matching tracks; keep rates above the unweighted average of the media type rates; report the rate minus that average

For each media type ID, calculate total `Bytes / Milliseconds` using only tracks with non-null `Bytes`; count only those tracks; keep rates above the unweighted average of the media type rates; report the rate minus that average

For each media type ID, calculate its rate from matching tracks, but include media types with no matching tracks as zero-rate types when computing the unweighted average; report qualifying types, their track counts, and their rates minus that average
Treat media types with the same `Name` as one type: combine their matching tracks to calculate a rate and count, then compare each name’s rate with the unweighted average across distinct names
For each qualifying media type, report how far its rate exceeds the unweighted average as a percentage of that average, alongside its name, rate, and track count

For each media type ID, calculate its rate as `AVG(Bytes) / AVG(Milliseconds)`, count all matching tracks, and compare it with the unweighted average of those rates. This can differ from dividing the totals when `Bytes` is null

For each media type ID, average its tracks’ non-null `Bytes / Milliseconds` rates, count only tracks that contribute to that average, and compare it with the unweighted average of the media type rates
queries:
WITH rates AS (
  SELECT
    MediaTypeId,
    COUNT(*) AS track_count,
    1.0 * SUM(Bytes) / SUM(Milliseconds) AS rate
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
),
average_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS value
  FROM rates
)
SELECT
  rates.MediaTypeId,
  rates.track_count,
  rates.rate - average_rate.value AS rate_above_average
FROM rates
CROSS JOIN average_rate
WHERE rates.rate > average_rate.value

WITH media_type_rates AS (
    SELECT
        MediaTypeId,
        AVG(1.0 * Bytes / Milliseconds) AS rate,
        COUNT(*) AS track_count
    FROM Track
    GROUP BY MediaTypeId
)
SELECT
    MediaTypeId,
    rate,
    track_count,
    rate - (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM media_type_rates) AS rate_difference
FROM media_type_rates
WHERE rate > (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM media_type_rates)

WITH media_rates AS (
    SELECT
        MediaTypeId,
        COUNT(*) AS TrackCount,
        1.0 * SUM(Bytes) / SUM(Milliseconds) AS Rate
    FROM Track
    WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY MediaTypeId
)
SELECT
    MediaTypeId,
    TrackCount,
    Rate - (SELECT AVG(Rate) FROM media_rates) AS RateAboveAverage
FROM media_rates
WHERE Rate > (SELECT AVG(Rate) FROM media_rates);

WITH media_rates AS (
    SELECT
        MediaTypeId,
        COUNT(*) AS track_count,
        1.0 * SUM(Bytes) / SUM(Milliseconds) AS rate
    FROM Track
    WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY MediaTypeId
),
average_rate AS (
    SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM media_rates
)
SELECT
    m.MediaTypeId,
    m.track_count,
    m.rate,
    m.rate - a.rate AS rate_above_average
FROM media_rates AS m
CROSS JOIN average_rate AS a
WHERE m.rate > a.rate

WITH media_type_rates AS (
    SELECT
        m.MediaTypeId,
        COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count,
        COALESCE(AVG(t.UnitPrice), 0) AS rate
    FROM MediaType AS m
    LEFT JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
    GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId
)
SELECT
    MediaTypeId,
    track_count,
    rate - (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM media_type_rates) AS rate_minus_average
FROM media_type_rates
WHERE rate > (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM media_type_rates)
